IBKR on Tuesday announced that clients can now stake Ethereum through its Client Portal, with staking services provided by zerohash.
Investors can submit staking and unstaking requests, monitor transactions and earn rewards credited as additional staked cryptocurrency, allowing returns to compound.

"Similar to how our Stock Yield Enhancement Program allows clients to earn additional income on shares they own, staking gives clients an opportunity to earn rewards on the cryptocurrency they own," said CEO
The brokerage currently supports trading in 20 cryptocurrencies, including
The staking launch expands Interactive Brokers’ digital asset offerings beyond trading.
The platform also supports stablecoin funding through USDC,
, alongside crypto transfers to custodial and self-custody wallets.
By integrating staking, stablecoin funding and crypto trading with stocks, options, futures and bonds, Interactive Brokers is expanding access to digital assets within traditional brokerage accounts.
The move also highlights growing competition among financial platforms to offer crypto services beyond simple buying and selling.
However, staking rewards are not guaranteed, and investors remain exposed to crypto price volatility and staking-related risks.
